ns2:course.label: Design II, Workshops
ns2:course.description: Theory and practice in the elements, processes and principles of design divided into three, five-week workshops on the topics of: Time, formal and technical aspects of working in temporal media such as sound, video or animation; Materials/Exploration, process-drive exploration with an emphasis on three-dimensional space and form; Research, methods for achieving research-drive projects. Prerequisite: ARTF 103.
